simple.summary: שְׁמִידָע (Shᵉmîydâʻ) means Shemida , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 7 19.

definitions.full: H8061. Shemida שְׁמִידָ֑ע proper name, masculine in Manasseh ( the name knoweth? compare Sabean ירעסמהו DHM ZMG xxxvii (1883), 16 ); — Num 26:22 ( συμαερ ), Josh 17:2 ; 1Chr 7:19 , συμαρειμ , etc.; ᵐ5 L σαμ ( ε ) ιδα ( ε ).
